## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/popup-menu`.

### `PopupMenuComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-popup-menu`  
**API reference:** [`PopupMenuComponent`](/api/popup-menu/PopupMenuComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | `ElementRef<HTMLElement> \| Element` | — | The element to position the menu against, when it isn't the `target`. Ignored when `openAtPointer` is set. |
| `anchorConnectionPoint` | `ConnectionPoint \| null` | — | The point on the anchor that the menu attaches to. Ignored when `openAtPointer` is set. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `""` | The accessible name of the root menu. Takes precedence over `aria-labelledby`. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | `""` | The ids of the elements that name the root menu. When neither this nor `aria-label` is set, the menu is named by the target element if it has an id. |
| `class` | `ClassInputType` | `undefined` | Extra classes for the menu's popup. |
| `id` | `string` | `""` | The id of the popup menu's root element. |
| `items` | `Iterable<PopupMenuItem \| MenuItem>` | `[]` | The items to render in the popup menu. If provided, it will override the menu items defined by projected menu item components. |
| `minWidth` | `string \| number` | — | Sets the minimum width of the popup menu. This will be applied to the root menu and all submenus. |
| `offset` | `PopupOffset` | — | The distance between the menu and its anchor. |
| `openAtPointer` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens the menu where the pointer is, instead of against the `anchor` or `target`. Opened from the keyboard, it opens at the center of the target. |
| `popupConnectionPoint` | `ConnectionPoint \| null` | — | The point on the menu that attaches to the anchor. Ignored when `openAtPointer` is set. |
| `rounded` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "none" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Sets the border radius of the popup menu. This will be applied to the root menu and all submenus. |
| `size` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Sets the size of the popup menu. This will be applied to the root menu and all submenus. |
| `target` (required) | `ElementRef<HTMLElement> \| Element` | — | The element that opens the menu. The menu is positioned against it unless `anchor` is set. |
| `trigger` | `PopupMenuTrigger` | `"click"` | What opens the menu: a click on the target, a right-click on it, or `"none"` to open it only through `openMenu()`. |
| `width` | `string \| number` | — | Sets the width of the popup menu. This will be applied to the root menu and all submenus. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `PopupMenuCloseEvent` | The event that is emitted when the popup menu is closed. |
| `menuClick` | `PopupMenuItemClickEvent` | The event that is emitted when a menu item is clicked. |
| `navigate` | `PopupMenuNavigationEvent` | Emitted when an arrow key moves through the menu, or tries to leave it. |
| `open` | `void` | The event that is emitted when the popup menu is opened. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clearFocusRestoration(): void` | Keeps focus where it is when the open menu closes, instead of returning it to the element that had it before the menu opened. Used when another menu takes over, as in a menubar. |
| `closeMenu(): void` | Closes the menu. Focus returns to the element that had it before the menu opened, unless focus has already moved elsewhere. |
| `openMenu(viaContextMenuKey: boolean = false): void` | Opens the menu, as if the target had been clicked. |
| `openMenuViaKeyboard(viaContextMenuKey: boolean = false, focus: PopupMenuInitialFocus = "first"): void` | Opens the menu as the keyboard does, with its first (or last) item highlighted. |
| `setRestoreFocusForKeyboard(): void` | **Deprecated.** Focus now returns to the element that had it before the menu opened after every close. |

### `PopupMenuCheckboxItemComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-popup-menu-checkbox-item`  
**API reference:** [`PopupMenuCheckboxItemComponent`](/api/popup-menu/PopupMenuCheckboxItemComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` (two-way) | `boolean` | `false` | The checked state of the menu item. Activating the item toggles it (unless its `menuClick` is prevented) and emits `checkedChange`, so it works with or without a two-way binding. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the disabled state of the menu item. |
| `label` | `string` | `""` | The text of the menu item. |
| `value` | `unknown` | — | A value that identifies the item. It's the `value` of the item's `menuClick` events. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checkedChange` | `boolean` | Emitted when `checked` changes. |
| `menuClick` | `PopupMenuItemClickEvent` | The click event of the menu item. Emits when the menu item is selected by keyboard or mouse. |

### `PopupMenuItemComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-popup-menu-item`  
**API reference:** [`PopupMenuItemComponent`](/api/popup-menu/PopupMenuItemComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the disabled state of the menu item. |
| `label` | `string` | `""` | The text of the menu item. |
| `value` | `unknown` | — | A value that identifies the item. It's the `value` of the item's `menuClick` events, so handlers don't depend on the label's text. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `menuClick` | `PopupMenuItemClickEvent` | The click event of the menu item. Emits when the menu item is selected by keyboard or mouse. |

### `PopupMenuRadioItemComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-popup-menu-radio-item`  
**API reference:** [`PopupMenuRadioItemComponent`](/api/popup-menu/PopupMenuRadioItemComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the disabled state of the menu item. |
| `label` | `string` | `""` | The text of the menu item. |
| `value` (required) | `string` | — | The value of the radio item. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `menuClick` | `PopupMenuItemClickEvent` | The click event of the menu item. Emits when the menu item is selected by keyboard or mouse, before the radio group selects it. Preventing it keeps the group's value and the menu open. |

### `PopupMenuItemClickEvent`

Emitted when a menu item is activated by a click, Enter or Space. Preventing it keeps the menu open and leaves a
checkbox or radio item's state unchanged.

**Extends:** `PreventableEvent`  
**API reference:** [`PopupMenuItemClickEvent`](/api/popup-menu/PopupMenuItemClickEvent)

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` (read-only) | `boolean \| undefined` | For a checkbox or radio item, the state the item has once the click is applied (if it isn't prevented). `undefined` for other items. |
| `label` (read-only) | `string` | The item's label. |
| `value` (read-only) | `unknown` | The item's `value`: the `value` input of the item component, or the `value` of a `MenuItem`. |
